fleet.verification: API-key access plus private-beta headers required
fleet.notes: Session creation is an ordinary write: organization bucket burst 20, refill 10 requests/s. High-frequency event/session-update/deployment-run endpoints instead get burst 100, refill 50/s. Platform may vary values by account or endpoint; concurrency quota is unpublished.

snapshot_auto.quote: 开启后，平台会在成功执行结束时尝试保存快照，下一轮优先从最近一次成功快照恢复；失败轮不更新快照。
snapshot_auto.note: Opt-in per session at creation with header x-checkpoint: true (x-checkpoint-ttl 1-30 days, default 30). Triggered automatically at the end of each successful turn (session returns to idle); the next turn restores from the latest successful snapshot. Disk only: 'Checkpoint 只保留磁盘，不保留正在运行的进程和内存状态。' Best-effort: subject to account quota/service availability, falls back to a fresh sandbox on failure. Without it, /workspace, /tmp and runtime-installed packages are lost between turns; /mnt/session/outputs always persists.

harness_api.quote: 先订阅 SSE，再把用户消息作为事件发送；Agent 自主调用工具并实时回传。事件历史在服务端持久化，可随时完整拉取。
harness_api.note: The product is a harness API (Anthropic Managed Agents-style Agent/Environment/Session/Events): POST /v1/sessions/:id/events (user.message, user.interrupt, tool confirmations, custom tool results), GET /v1/sessions/:id/events/stream (SSE), event history list, session list/get/archive, scheduled Deployments (cron). Harness is Zhipu's own platform-run agent loop on glm-5.3 / glm-5.3-flash / glm-5.3-flashx only; not Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode. Private beta (header zai-beta: managed-agents-2026-05-26).

egress_allowlist.quote: 出站网络受 Environment 网络策略控制（unrestricted / limited + allowed_hosts），并统一限制为 HTTP/HTTPS 端口 80/443；由平台侧网关强制执行。
egress_allowlist.note: Environment networking: 'unrestricted' (default, public hosts on ports 80/443 only) or 'limited' with allowed_hosts (up to 256 hostnames or *.example.com wildcards; no scheme/port/path), plus allow_package_managers and allow_mcp_servers toggles. Enforced by a platform-side gateway. Ports are hard-limited to 80/443 in all modes; no IP/CIDR rules.

secret_proxy.quote: Agent 与沙箱拿不到凭据原文；MCP 与 HTTPS 出站由平台侧注入，不进入提示词。
secret_proxy.note: Vault credential types: static_bearer / mcp_oauth (MCP servers), bearer / oauth for any plain HTTPS host (identity key = host; OAuth auto-refresh), and environment_variable: the sandbox sees an omasec_ placeholder and 'the real secret is substituted into the outbound request only when the target host matches the credential networking rule' ('真实密钥仅在目标主机命中该凭据 networking 规则时由平台代入出站请求'). Secrets are write-only (never echoed). HTTP(S) only: sandbox egress is limited to ports 80/443, so no database/SSH/raw git-over-SSH coverage.

volume_shared.quote: Memory Store 是持久的——挂载到任意多个会话，Agent 在工作中读取和沉淀记忆，你可以随时审计每一次变更。
volume_shared.note: One Memory Store can be mounted into many concurrent sessions, read-write or read-only (docs: '共享记忆用 read_only：多个 Agent 共享一份知识库时，只给需要沉淀的会话 read_write'); writes become versioned Memory entries with sha256 preconditions for concurrent edits. Text-memory semantics, not a general POSIX network FS. Uploaded Files can also be mounted read-only into multiple sessions.

image_oci.quote: 自定义 registry / source / index URL 与私有源凭据配置一律拒绝（400 Extra inputs are not permitted）
image_oci.note: Environment only supports declaring apt/pip/npm/etc. packages on top of a fixed baseline image; there is no way to start a session from a customer-supplied Docker/OCI image.

nested_virt.quote: Docker CLI 29.x 含 Buildx、Compose；仅 CLI，沙箱内不运行 Docker daemon
nested_virt.note: Docker CLI is installed but the daemon cannot run inside; no /dev/kvm or nested-VM capability is mentioned anywhere in the docs.

desktop.quote: Z Managed Agents 提供云端托管的 Agent 运行环境，帮助开发者降低构建 Agent Runtime、执行环境和任务编排的复杂度
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — it is an API-driven headless agent/tool sandbox (bash, file ops), with no VNC/RDP/stream graphical desktop.

computer_use.quote: 内置工具集（agent_toolset_20260601）当前包含以下工具 ... Bash / Read / Write / Edit / Grep / Find / Ls
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the built-in toolset is code/file/shell tools only; there is no screenshot+click computer-use API.

anti_bot.quote: Playwright（Python 与 Node 同版本）+ 共享 Chromium（Chrome for Testing），配合 Xvfb 虚拟显示，可直接做网页截图、抓取与端到端测试
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a plain Playwright/Chromium browser for the agent's own testing/scraping tool use, with no stealth/fingerprint-evasion features described.

captcha_solving.quote: Playwright（Python 与 Node 同版本）+ 共享 Chromium（Chrome for Testing），配合 Xvfb 虚拟显示，可直接做网页截图、抓取与端到端测试
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no CAPTCHA-solving capability is documented anywhere.

egress_ip_type.quote: 出站网络受 Environment 网络策略控制（unrestricted / limited + allowed_hosts），并统一限制为 HTTP/HTTPS 端口 80/443；由平台侧网关强制执行
egress_ip_type.note: derived: all outbound traffic is forced through the platform's own gateway (cloud datacenter egress); no residential/mobile/static-IP egress option is offered.

ssh.quote: 通过 API 定义并启动 Agent 会话，即可让 Agent 在云端调用工具、处理文件、执行命令，并持续完成复杂任务
ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the only way to interact with the sandbox is via the Managed Agents API/events (bash tool executed by the agent); no user SSH access is documented.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: 开启后，平台会在成功执行结束时尝试保存快照，下一轮优先从最近一次成功快照恢复；失败轮不更新快照。
snapshot_on_demand.note: Checkpoint saving is automatic-only, triggered by the platform at the end of each successful turn when x-checkpoint:true was set at session creation. There is no API/CLI call to take a snapshot on demand at an arbitrary point; snapshot:"fs" describes the mechanism's kind (disk-only), not an on-demand trigger, so no real contradiction with on_demand=false.

fork.quote: 端点总表：按资源列出全部接口（Agents / Environments / Sessions / Files / Memory Stores / Vaults / Skills / Deployments）
fork.note: derived: the full endpoint list has no fork/clone operation for sessions or their sandboxes.

fork_running.quote: 端点总表：按资源列出全部接口（Agents / Environments / Sessions / Files / Memory Stores / Vaults / Skills / Deployments）
fork_running.note: derived: no fork capability exists at all (see fork), so cloning a running machine is not possible.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: Checkpoint 只保留磁盘，不保留正在运行的进程和内存状态
memory_snapshot_fork.note: Checkpoints are disk-only (no running-process/memory state), and no fork feature exists, so a memory-preserving fork is not possible.

pause_resume.quote: Managed Agents 在设计上是有状态的：会话长时间运行、可在暂停后恢复，对话历史与产出保存在服务端。
pause_resume.note: Official docs explicitly state sessions can run long and be resumed after being paused ('可在暂停后恢复'). Between turns a session goes to 'idle' (no active compute billed) and resumes on the next message; with x-checkpoint:true the disk state (not running processes/RAM) is restored automatically on resume - matches the pause_resume definition (billing paused/reduced across pause), consistent with snapshot_auto=true.

wake_on_request.quote: 会话进入 running：平台按环境快照供给沙箱、挂载资源与 Skill、启动 Agent 循环
wake_on_request.note: An idle session has no provisioned sandbox until a new user.message event arrives, at which point the platform automatically provisions the sandbox again (optionally restoring the last checkpoint).

persistent_disk.note: Output files persist across turns (sandbox stop/start) by default; /workspace and /tmp persist too if x-checkpoint is enabled.

volume_attach.quote: resources 可选。挂载 Memory Store 与 File Resource（合计最多 508 项）
volume_attach.note: Sessions can mount Memory Stores and File Resources (application-level, not a POSIX filesystem), but there is no generic attachable block-volume feature.

auto_stop_idle.quote: 默认情况下，/tmp 与运行期安装的包（如 pip install）不跨轮保留
auto_stop_idle.note: The sandbox is released/reset at the end of each turn/session by default (unless checkpointing is enabled), which functions as automatic stop-on-idle.

live_resize.quote: 沙箱与运行环境：当前限时免费。后续计费规则以平台公告为准
live_resize.note: not offered: no CPU/RAM resize API is documented; sandbox sizing is fixed and not published/adjustable via the API.

agent_harnesses.quote: 模型用量：按会话实际调用的模型（目前支持 glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash、glm-5.3-flashx）
agent_harnesses.note: The platform runs its own GLM-based agent loop only; there is no offering of third-party coding-agent harnesses like Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.

own_agent_api.quote: 先订阅 SSE，再把用户消息作为事件发送；Agent 自主调用工具并实时回传。事件历史在服务端持久化，可随时完整拉取
own_agent_api.note: First-party API (Agents/Environments/Sessions/Events) drives Zhipu's own task agent loop (bash/file tools, MCP, custom tools) end-to-end.

public_ipv4.quote: 出站网络受 Environment 网络策略控制 ... 由平台侧网关强制执行
public_ipv4.note: not offered: only outbound (egress) networking through a platform gateway is documented; no per-sandbox public IPv4 is mentioned.

inbound_https.quote: 镜像内不包含任何 API Key、Session token 或云存储凭据；Agent 只拿到单次执行所需的运行时配置
inbound_https.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no port-exposure/inbound-URL feature is documented; interaction is only via the Events API.

ingress_rules.quote: 网络与安全：出站网络受 Environment 网络策略控制 ... 并统一限制为 HTTP/HTTPS 端口 80/443
ingress_rules.note: derived: documented network controls are outbound (egress) only; there is no inbound exposure to control in the first place.

egress_http_rules.quote: allowed_hosts：最多 256 项；每项是主机名或 *.example.com 通配，不得带协议前缀、端口或路径
egress_http_rules.note: Egress control is host/domain-level (allowed_hosts) only; there is no HTTP method/path-level egress rule capability.

static_egress_ip.quote: 出站网络受 Environment 网络策略控制 ... 由平台侧网关强制执行
static_egress_ip.note: not offered: egress goes through a shared platform-side gateway; no fixed/dedicated outbound IP feature is documented.

gpu.quote: 基础系统：Ubuntu 24.04 LTS，架构 linux/amd64（x86_64），时区 Etc/UTC，locale C.UTF-8
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Managed Agents is a coding/tool-use CPU sandbox; no GPU option is mentioned anywhere in the docs.

windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the sandbox image is fixed to Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 amd64).

macos.quote: 基础系统：Ubuntu 24.04 LTS，架构 linux/amd64（x86_64）
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Linux-only sandbox image.

self_host.quote: Z Managed Agents 提供云端托管的 Agent 运行环境，帮助开发者降低构建 Agent Runtime、执行环境和任务编排的复杂度
self_host.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — it is described purely as a cloud-hosted managed service, with no self-hosting/on-prem option mentioned.

byoc.quote: Z Managed Agents 提供云端托管的 Agent 运行环境
byoc.note: not offered: no bring-your-own-cloud deployment option is documented; the service runs only in Zhipu's own cloud (agent-api.bigmodel.cn).

open_source.quote: Z Managed Agents 提供云端托管的 Agent 运行环境，帮助开发者降低构建 Agent Runtime、执行环境和任务编排的复杂度
open_source.note: not offered: it is a proprietary hosted platform/API; no OSI-licensed open-source release of the Managed Agents runtime is documented.

sso.quote: 目前以 API 开放内测，控制台等更多功能近期即将推出
sso.note: not offered: the product is currently API-key-only (Bearer token from the open-platform console) with no console/web login yet ('console coming soon'), so there is no SAML/OIDC SSO surface today.

docker_inside.quote: Docker CLI | 29.x | 含 Buildx、Compose；仅 CLI，沙箱内不运行 Docker daemon
docker_inside.note: The sandbox ships the Docker CLI (with Buildx/Compose) but explicitly does not run a Docker daemon inside the sandbox, so containers cannot actually be built/run inside it.

arm64.quote: 基础系统：Ubuntu 24.04 LTS，架构 linux/amd64（x86_64）
arm64.note: The sandbox base image is explicitly x86_64 (linux/amd64) only; no ARM architecture is offered.

eu_data_residency.note: Managed Agents is a Zhipu AI (bigmodel.cn) product served from a single Chinese API domain (agent-api.bigmodel.cn); no regions, EU or otherwise, are documented or selectable anywhere in the API reference, overview, or pricing docs. No EU residency option is offered; product is China/Asia-only, so confidence is medium per the 'plainly outside what the product is' rule.

usage_api.quote: 响应中值得关注的运行时字段：status（当前真实状态）、usage（累计 input / output / cache_read token）
usage_api.note: granularity: per-sandbox; cost: no; GET /v1/sessions/:sessionId returns a usage field containing input_tokens, output_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens. Each session is a sandbox. Usage is reported as token counts, not cost; billing/cost monitoring is handled separately on the platform's billing side.
